C1341.title: Quantum Year Clock Set for 2030, Public-Key Encryption Faces Quantum Threat
C1341.summary: Digital security experts have established a "Quantum Year" (Y2Q) clock, predicting that a general-purpose quantum computer could break widely used public-key encryption such as RSA by April 14, 2030. The co-chair of the Cloud Security Alliance's Quantum-Safe Security Working Group noted that once a quantum computer emerges, existing encrypted communications will no longer be secure.
